verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native Slack-channel posting, Notion sync, or Zapier integration for Fellow notes. Slack appears only as a meeting source (recording Slack Huddles), not as a destination for notes. The REST API, webhooks, and MCP server are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier
